verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs describe a built-in AI Modeler that builds financial models from plain-language input, with AI running inside the model and returning answers. That is a first-party in-product assistant users can hand modeling work to. The evidence is only short marketing lines, so the range of delegable tasks and how far the assistant acts on its own are unproven. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which tasks the assistant can carry out, evidence of multi-step or agentic task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Meet AI Modeler: financial models in plain language. No formulas needed.
Abacum runs AI inside your model, so every answer is consistent, reusable, and grounded in how your business actually works.
